concerns.text: T019 (Filtering) is listed AFTER T015/T015b/T015c (Downloads) but BEFORE T018 (Merge). However, T018's logic explicitly states 'Dependency: T019'. This creates a valid chain (Download -> Filter -> Merge). BUT, T020 (Scoring) depends on T018. The critical issue is T012 (Sample Size Verification) in Phase 4. T012 depends on T018 (Merge). T012 is a GATE for US3. However, US3 (Phase 6) tasks T032/T033 depend on T020 (US1) and T029 (US2). The ordering of US2 (Phase 5) and US3 (Phase 6) is correct. The issue is T007b: 'Update state... after T007 generates them'. T007 is marked [P] (parallel) but T007b explicitly depends on T007. If T007 and T007b run in parallel, T007b will fail. T007b must be sequential to T007.

T007b is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but its description explicitly states 'Dependency: T007. Must wait for T007 to complete.' This is a direct contradiction. A task cannot be parallel-safe if it has a hard dependency on another task in the same phase that produces its input. T007b must be removed from the [P] group or T007 must be split to ensure T007b runs after T007.

T015, T015b, T015c are all marked [P] (parallel). They download different datasets (HCI_P2, Persona-Chat, EmpatheticDialogues). This is valid. However, T019 (Filtering) depends on the output of ALL three. T019 is NOT marked [P], which is correct. But T018 (Merge) depends on T019. T020 (Scoring) depends on T018. The flow is correct. The issue is T012 (Phase 4) which depends on T018. T012 is a gate for US3. US3 tasks (T032, T033) depend on T020 (US1) and T029 (US2). The ordering of US2 and US3 is correct. The issue is T027d (Fallback) which depends on T027a. T027d is marked [P] in the list? No, it's not marked [P]. Wait, T027d is not marked [P]. T027a is not marked [P]. T028 depends on T027a and T027d. T029 depends on T028 and T027d. The flow is correct. The issue is T032c (LIWC) which depends on T020 and T032. T032c is marked [P]? No. T033 depends on T032b. T033b depends on T033 and T029. The flow is correct. The issue is T034 (Subgroup) which depends on T012 and T020. T012 is in Phase 4. T020 is in Phase 3. T034 is in Phase 6. This is correct. The issue is T007b again. It is marked [P] but depends on T007. This is a hard ordering violation.
